blocks.text:
Think in slides. Let AI build them.
Every slide in this deck demonstrates the feature it describes.

Vela is an agent-native presentation engine. Run it in a Claude.ai artifact, a local browser, or a native desktop window — and Vera, the built-in AI, turns your descriptions into structured slides. No design skills. No separate tools. Just intent to output.
Same engine, three runtimes — Claude.ai artifact, local browser server, or native desktop. Vera routes to whichever AI backend is available.
The gap between thinking and presenting should be zero.

blocks.text: Every text element supports **bold** and *italic* markdown. Sizes from xs to 4xl. Headings use Sora, body uses DM Sans, code uses Space Mono.
Semantic blocks carry meaning — a flow is a process, not a box with arrows.

blocks.text: SVG blocks use {{accent}}, {{color}}, {{muted}}, {{bg}} tokens — they adapt to any theme automatically.
Two-column slides using **L** (left) and **R** (right) block arrays — works with any block type.

L.text: Place any blocks side-by-side — text, metrics, flows, tables. Ratio control via **contentFlex / imageFlex**.
L.title: Flexible Columns

blocks.text: Two new ways to navigate and manage your decks — visual sorting and conflict-free updates.
Slide sorter with real thumbnails. **Drag-and-drop** reorder, 7 zoom levels, per-module color bars. Press **G** in fullscreen.
Detects new embedded deck versions. Per-item conflict resolution — **Keep Mine**, **Use New**, or **Keep Both**.
Set once, apply to every slide. Accent bar, logo position, footer text, and custom colors.
Vera can set branding programmatically: "Add a red accent bar with 'Acme Corp' in the footer" — done across all slides instantly.
Vera becomes a teaching assistant in presenter mode. Slides can embed **studyNotes** — offline-first markdown with diagrams, follow-up questions, and a glossary for Kindle-style X-Ray term popups.
This slide has studyNotes attached — look for the 🎓 marker. Enter fullscreen, click 🎓 to see offline content with glossary terms you can tap to explore.

studyNotes.text:
**Student Mode** transforms Vela into an interactive learning tool. Each slide can embed pre-authored study content that renders with *zero API calls*.

The key insight: slides contain the presentation narrative, while [studyNotes](#studynotes) contain the deeper learning material. This separation means presenters see clean slides, while students get rich, offline-first study content.

Study notes support **markdown** formatting, inline [glossary](#glossary) terms (tap to see definitions), and follow-up questions that become interactive when a live API channel is available.
questions: Why is offline-first important for training environments?
How do glossary popups improve comprehension compared to footnotes?
When would you use studyNotes vs. live Vera Teacher mode?

studynotes.definition: Pre-authored markdown content embedded in slides that renders offline. Includes text, SVG diagrams, follow-up questions, and a glossary for X-Ray term popups.

glossary.definition: A set of term definitions (max 24) that power Kindle-style X-Ray popups. Terms are linked inline using [term](#key) syntax.

blocks.text: Lanes and modules on the left. Drag to reorder, click to jump. Press **[** to toggle.
In fullscreen, hover the left edge for a **searchable table of contents** across all modules.
Click any text on a slide to edit it directly — even in fullscreen. **Bold** and *italic* markdown.
Claude.ai blocks native fullscreen. Click the **⛵ icon** to get a bookmarklet for true browser fullscreen.
An agentic AI assistant *inside* every Vela runtime — backend-agnostic, with 20 tools for deck manipulation. She builds, edits, searches, and restyles without leaving the canvas.
From a single block to the entire deck — every edit supports Ctrl+Z undo.
Press **E** on any slide. Describe a change in natural language. Paste an image as visual reference.
Vera analyzes the current slide with layout stats and suggests improvements — density, hierarchy, visual balance.
Generate 4 design directions. Preview with **1-4** keys, accept with **Enter**, dismiss with **Esc**.
Restyle or improve across a **module**, **section**, or the **full deck**. One command, consistent output.
A full deck authoring pipeline — from compact JSON to assembled artifact in one command. Three interchangeable formats for every stage.

# One command does it all
vela deck ship my-deck.json

# Edit without opening files
vela slide edit deck.json 3 block.2.text "New title"
vela deck replace-text deck.json "old" "new"
